script_text: Something profound and deeply unexpected is shifting the cosmic tides for Water sign Pisces this very same week. Monday through Wednesday, Saturn squares your 10th House of Career, creating frustrating delays and blocking professional ambitions. You must navigate these heavy waters with immense patience to survive this grueling transit. Your ruling planet Jupiter forms a powerful trine to Neptune on Thursday, initiating a crucial midweek turning point. This Water element activation brings profound clarity to your love life and unlocks hidden financial opportunities through your 2nd House of Money. By the weekend, romantic abundance flows freely into your world. Wednesday is your power day because Jupiter enters your 7th House of Love. Monday is your worst day due to that Saturn square. Release your rigid control over your career and trust the universe to handle the rest of your path. Follow for your daily updates.
